query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Larchmere . Across all the Larchmere water listings and all their pack sizes, which seller offers the lowest price per litre among packs that can actually be bought?

The search results list 42 listings on 2 pages; there is no further page. 21 of them are the water the question asks about, by their titles, and only those are part of the question.

Open every listing above. The results page shows each listing's cheapest option, not its price per litre, so no listing can be ruled out from it.
In each one, choose each pack size in turn, then look at the page again and read the price it now shows. The price a listing shows before you choose is its cheapest option that can be bought, not necessarily the pack you are pricing, and the reply to choosing an option does not show the new price. Count only a pack that can actually be bought. A pack can be listed and still be unavailable, in which case it is shown as disabled or greyed out and cannot be chosen from the menu, so it has no price you can use. Then work out the price per litre of each pack, from its price and its volume, the number of bottles times each bottle's volume as its label gives them, and keep the listing's best.
In your answer, name the seller with the lowest price per litre, the pack and the price you read for it, and say how many listings you opened. Only report a price you read while that pack was chosen, never the price shown before choosing.

result.final: The seller with the lowest price per litre among packs that can actually be bought is **Crowhurst Pantry Stores**, with the **24 x 350ml** pack at **$7.94** (8.4 litres, **$0.945/L**). I opened all 21 Larchmere water listings and checked every available pack size on each product page, selecting each enabled option and reading the price displayed after selection. Disabled/unavailable packs were excluded.
